frases.es: La luz de la sala de reuniones está apagada.
frases.en: The light in the meeting room is off.

frases.en: There's a report on the desk and everyone's gone from work.

frases.es: Parece que ahora no queda nadie en la oficina.
frases.en: Looks like there's no one left in the office now.

frases.ko: 오늘 회의가 없잖아요. 그래서 일찍 퇴근한 것 같아요.
frases.es: Hoy no hay reunión, ya sabes. Por eso parece que se fueron temprano.
frases.en: There's no meeting today, you know. That's why they seem to have left early.
